purpose: 28 question-specific review HYPOTHESES from actual pinned authored primary/transfer crux; 7 source-rival gaps intentionally block contract compilation; not academic/Owner validation
archival_rule: Never rewrite canonical source/golden; verify exact source and manifest SHA before reading assertions.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner independently explains why equal squares are insufficient and connects non-reversible squaring with the nonnegative principal-root constraint on the original equation's whole right-hand side, then rejects the spurious candidate for the correct reason.
witnesses.success_evidence: An uncued learner states the one-way logical implication, applies the sign constraint to the original equation, rejects -1 for a valid reason, independently verifies x=4, and explains why the changed absolute-value right side admits the formerly extraneous candidate.

falsifier.hypothesis: If the pre-attempt stages or accessible SVG title already state the sign-loss and required right-side sign argument, the learner is only repeating a supplied EXPLAIN chain; mutation must expose this.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner selects either relevant drink count as a variable, derives its complementary count from exactly nine sold, independently constructs the weighted revenue equation and checks the integer count; the corresponding ticket transfer requires a new feasibility model rather than substitution.
witnesses.success_evidence: Before any solution disclosure the learner names a consistent count variable, represents the other count as 9 minus that value, constructs either mathematically equivalent price-weighted total, verifies integer counts against both givens, then models the changed ticket case and explains infeasibility using whole-count constraints.

falsifier.hypothesis: If the Core2A stem or pre-attempt H2 already provides both variable meaning and the winning weighted equation, the learner merely applies an announced model; negative mutation must trigger MODEL-W exposure.

witnesses.question_specific_W: The claim to assess is that the learner reconstructs the appropriate right-triangle distance relation and edge-route sum, connects the two lengths to the travel cap, and can later reverse the hypotenuse relation; unprompted method selection is already falsified by the primary stem.
witnesses.success_evidence: A learner independently states or reconstructs the actual positive-root diagonal relation and adjacent-edge sum, computes 15m against 21m with an 18m allowance, explains why d-squared is not a measured length, then solves the inverse 13-5 transfer without copying a supplied numeric route.

falsifier.hypothesis: The primary stem explicitly tells the learner to retrieve the right-triangle distance relation, falsifying a claim that the learner independently selects that method; qualified academic comparison with APPLY remains unresolved.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner independently retrieves the applicable full necessary-and-sufficient odd-square classification for modulus 128, uses it to discriminate unfamiliar residues, then recognizes the exceptional modulus-four rule in a changed transfer rather than following an earlier disclosed iff theorem.
witnesses.success_evidence: Given odd residues modulo 128 the learner states the correct threshold-specific iff rule from legitimate prior knowledge, classifies six new residues without brute force, distinguishes necessity from sufficiency, and independently revises the criterion for modulo four on a fresh test.

falsifier.hypothesis: If Core1A or its earlier accessible stages reveal the complete k-at-least-three iff criterion before the primary attempt, or if learner knowledge Y has not been demonstrated, the asserted unprompted D4 RETRIEVE success cannot be certified.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner independently chooses and constructs six repeated groups of four seedlings as a faithful equal-groups model, with the units and one-time counting explanation, then reverses to determine the unknown count of equally filled trays from a total of 24 and size four.
witnesses.success_evidence: Before being shown the winning operation, the learner identifies six trays versus four seedlings per tray, draws or writes six equal groups, explains why each seedling is counted once, gives 24 seedlings, and later decides independently to divide 24 by four to recover six trays.

falsifier.hypothesis: The stem's explicit wording six identical trays EACH containing four may preselect the entire equal-groups model, reducing the learner's decision to executing multiplication; a qualified reviewer must compare APPLY and REPRESENT and inspect earlier Core1A disclosure.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner independently coordinates the three-blue and two-red parts into one complete repeated motif, chooses a grouped or distributed expression representing all four repeats, and explains why a partial repeated component fails; reverse case first constructs full-block size then determines the unknown block count.
witnesses.success_evidence: The learner supplies either 4×(3+2) or 4×3+4×2, justifies why both colors are counted in every one of four copies, rejects 3+2×4 as incomplete, and independently reverses the 20-mark arrangement into four full mixed-component blocks.

falsifier.hypothesis: The visible stem specifies an identical repeating tile unit with both parts and may reduce the task to one familiar expression; a reviewer must determine whether dependent synthesis is real rather than ordinary modelling or application and whether D1 is justified.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner independently supplies a valid same-base same-perpendicular-altitude warrant showing triangles with sideways-displaced peaks have equal area, rather than merely multiplying the given base and height; transfer reverses the base-height implication to justify equal missing perpendicular altitudes.
witnesses.success_evidence: Before receiving the worked warrant, the learner explains that common 12 cm base and separately measured perpendicular 7 cm altitudes entail equal area despite different slanted edges, obtains 42 square cm for both with the correct reason, and independently infers 6 cm missing heights from equal 36 square-cm areas in transfer.

falsifier.hypothesis: If the question's wording perpendicular baseline and equal distances or an early support stage effectively gives the only area-equality warrant, the learner may only execute A=bh/2 and the claimed JUSTIFY demand is reduced to APPLY.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner independently connects common diagonal midpoints and diagonal perpendicularity to select the most-specific rhombus class, then uses unequal diagonal lengths to exclude square; changed case must retrieve the extra equal-diagonals criterion to solve the p parameter boundary.
witnesses.success_evidence: The learner computes the diagonals' shared midpoint, proves orthogonal directions, classifies the coordinate quadrilateral as rhombus and not square by unequal lengths, then identifies p=4 for the square boundary and classifies all other positive p without being handed criterion order.

falsifier.hypothesis: If the source/early stages explicitly order midpoint and perpendicular tests or already name the rhombus category, the claimed D3 category retrieval is cued; alternatively the mathematical work may be primarily JUSTIFY, demanding independent reviewer classification.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Learner independently identifies the shared positive exponential term 16^u=4^(2u), chooses a substitution t, derives the multiplicative offset 4t for 4^(2u+1) and constructs the consistent equation; transfer independently models the parameter sign boundary for real solutions.
witnesses.success_evidence: Before the shared substitution is disclosed, the learner derives 4^(2u+1)=4×16^u, chooses t=16^u>0, forms 4t=t+192, obtains t=64 and u=3/2, verifies the original, then deduces c>0 is necessary and sufficient and rejects c=-12 under changed-parameter conditions.

falsifier.hypothesis: The question stem explicitly asks for the shared positive quantity and its offset multiplier, potentially telling the learner how to model; the qualified reviewer must challenge whether this is truly MODEL-D3 rather than cued exponent-law APPLY and inspect cumulative Core1A/H2 help.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Retrieve the exact number-of-distinct-positive-divisors category criterion from memory, classify the complete divisor card {1,5,25} for 25 without oddness cues, and reverse the task by selecting which of three complete cards is prime.
witnesses.success_evidence: Before seeing the defining thresholds in hint text, learner counts three distinct positive divisors for 25, identifies COMPOSITE for the divisor-definition reason, excludes oddness as a rule, then selects the {1,23} prime card against 1 and 25.

falsifier.hypothesis: If Core1A teaching or preattempt H2 supplies the precise count threshold immediately before the task, observed performance may be prompted application of a stated definition rather than demonstrated independent RETRIEVE.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Independently articulate the pairing mechanism in which the one unmatched counter of seven and the one unmatched counter of nine join into a pair; then infer the necessary lone counter in a removed inverse subgroup instead of merely calculating sums.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner explicitly describes the two unmatched counters becoming one new pair and no leftover, not only 7+9=16; in the inverse 18-counter collection explains why the 11-counter remainder must have one unmatched counter to complement the given seven.

falsifier.hypothesis: If Core1A or H2 already connects the two lone counters into a pair in the exact target example, the observed answer repeats the causal mechanism rather than independently explaining it.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Correctly execute the supplied area relation A=length times width using the seven-by-four mat with square centimetre units, then reverse the same known relation for an area-24 width-four inverse length problem.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner substitutes 7 and 4 into the explicit formula to obtain 28 square centimetres, explains square unit rather than linear unit, then divides 24 by 4 to obtain six centimetres in the inverse transfer.

falsifier.hypothesis: If hints or diagrams already supply the 7×4 substitution or 28 cm² result, the target APPLY decision was performed for the learner, despite a correct final copied answer.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Maintain the east-positive horizontal and north-positive vertical sign conventions when converting four east and two south into the ordered displacement pair (4,-2), and invert a new signed pair (-3,+5) into words.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner independently puts +4 in horizontal x and -2 in vertical y with correct south-sign explanation, then converts (-3,+5) to three units west and five north and checks by re-encoding.

falsifier.hypothesis: If an accessible SVG or preattempt hint prelabels (4,-2) or directly converts the changed (-3,+5), representation preservation is no longer learner-owned.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Explain using factor-count semantics why 3^(t+1) is 3×3^t rather than 3^t+3, supply an additive counterexample, then explain the different duplicate-block rule for 2^(2k) instead of doubling the power.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner explicitly regroups t equal factors with one extra factor 3, gives an integer t that disproves addition, and in transfer constructs two k-factor blocks to show 2^(2k)=(2^k)^2 with an exact incorrect-doubling example.

falsifier.hypothesis: If H2 or prior concept work gives the entire same-exponent grouping and rejects the additive claim for the target t, the learner may be applying a narrated identity rather than explaining the causal link.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Apply sequential 25% then 10% reductions on the updated base of 960 credits rather than incorrectly adding percentages, then inverse-compose a 20% increase and 10% reduction from a final 1080 to reconstruct the original.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner computes 960×0.75=720 then 720×0.90=648, determines original-referenced 32.5% discount, and inversely recovers 1000 credits from 1080/(1.2×0.9) while stating net 8% increase.

falsifier.hypothesis: If the second-stage 720 base or the numerical 648 result is supplied in H1/H2, target updated-base execution is bypassed; simply adding percentages is a diagnostic error, not sufficient APPLY evidence.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Preserve the 5-by-7 tile count when turning a visually overlapping shading description into disjoint left 2×5 and upper-right 5×2 removals, then reconstruct an unlabeled six-row shape as a 6×8 enclosure minus a lower-right four-by-three notch.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner equates 35-(10+10)=15 with 3×5 unshaded tiles without double subtraction and, without a drawing, translates row lengths 8,8,5,5,5,5 to 48-12=36 and 2×8+4×5=36.

falsifier.hypothesis: If initial visual or H2 already marks the exact disjoint cut boundaries or Core2B presents the missing 4×3 corner, learner is no longer constructing the equivalence between representations.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Combine even last digit, divisible-by-three digit sum and lexicographically largest legal tens placement when building a three-digit multiple of six starting with four; transfer coordinates an invariant digit sum, a changed last-digit parity and a strictly smaller single-swap code.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner rejects 452 despite even final digit because digit sum 11, constructs 432 as the largest legal code and exhaustively tests exactly three swaps of 534 to identify 354 as the valid smaller divisible-by-six single swap.

falsifier.hypothesis: If the stem or H2 orders the two divisibility checks and names 432, synthesis route selection has been given away; if transfer only recomputes a known forward code it cannot demonstrate changed-constraint coordination.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Establish a universal factor-two and factor-three guarantee in any three consecutive integer factors and combine coprime divisibility into a valid proof of six; transfer refutes the excessive 48 universal claim and proves maximal 24 for four consecutive factors.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner does not mistake one factor divisible by six for the product proof: demonstrates always an even factor and a factor of three in the three-block, disproves universal 48 using k=1 yielding 24, and proves all four-block products multiples of 24.

falsifier.hypothesis: If the source or H2 supplies the universal parity/residue warrants or transfer maximality is inferred from finite examples only, JUSTIFY demand is bypassed despite correct sampled calculations.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Independently apply known prime-valuation ceilings to simultaneous constraints 72|n² and 135|n³, joining shared-prime requirements by maxima and proving minimality; reverse which divisor is squared or cubed in transfer.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner derives n divisible by 2²×3×5 =60 and proves necessary minimal prime valuations with both original checks, then recomputes least h=90 for switched constraints rather than reusing sixty.

falsifier.hypothesis: If H2 explicitly selects all prime thresholds or hands out n=60 and its minimality certificate, the protected D3 inferential application has been completed for the learner.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Represent east/north shortest-path families through P=(1,2), Q=(3,2) as overlapping sets and decide the physically feasible P-to-Q order; transfer changes Q=(2,1), demanding proof that shared path families become disjoint.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner maps geometric coordinate comparability to an overlap correction for 70 total paths (30 each through P/Q and nine through both, giving nineteen avoiding both), and for crossed P/Q coordinates proves shared count zero and ten avoiding both.

falsifier.hypothesis: If a diagram or H2 already supplies the three-part shared-path count or indicates overlap correction, there is no learner-owned representation-to-set bridge; carrying old overlap to crossed points must be rejected.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Independently coordinate three-digit arithmetic-progression constraints with base-ten leading and trailing bounds and divisibility by nine, choosing complete disjoint cases; changed transfer replaces nine by six and requires new parity-aware case synthesis.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner derives the digit-sum 3T, intersects the divisible-by-nine filter with all signed progression gaps and excludes leading zeros to count each three-digit candidate once; for divisible-by-six transfer the unit digit must be even, changing the case count.

falsifier.hypothesis: If the source or staged hints preselect all admissible middle digits or enumerate signed gaps before commitment, the synthesis of dependent constraints has been handed to the learner.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Provide a necessary-and-sufficient universal proof for when n(n+1)(n+2) is divisible by twelve, including an explicit nonexample and exhaustive modulo-four cases; transfer strengthens the divisor to twenty-four and derives all successful modulo-eight cases.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner disproves twelve for every positive n via n=1, proves twelve exactly when n modulo four is 0,2,3, and then proves twenty-four exactly for n even or n≡7 modulo8 using the permanent factor-three guarantee.

falsifier.hypothesis: If Core1A contains the identical iff classification or H2 supplies the complete residue list, subsequent learner case-checks do not independently establish the JUSTIFY warrant.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Explain the parity-dependent mod-eleven place-value mechanism when rotating the leading nonzero digit to the end, distinguishing even-length preservation from odd-length non-preservation, then extend reasoning to a two-digit prefix with a new odd-length exception.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner derives congruences showing an even original length preserves zero remainder, odd length has nonzero residual 2a modulo11 for a nonzero digit, and under two-digit rotation odd length survives exactly when prefix A is divisible by eleven, explaining 110 and 121 contrasts.

falsifier.hypothesis: If an early stage or SVG states the target even-versus-odd residue derivation or gives the two-digit prefix exception, learners merely repeat the decisive D4 causal explanation.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Apply a known noncoprime congruence-combination method with mandatory gcd compatibility checks for residues modulo12,18,20 within 200..600, and independently stop when a changed residue violates compatibility before evaluating a proposed repair.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner correctly combines x≡5 mod12 and x≡11 mod18 into x≡29 mod36, tests gcd(36,20)=4 against the third residue, derives x≡29 mod180 with eligible slots 209 and 389 and 569, and rejects changed x≡10 mod20 before checking repaired residue13.

falsifier.hypothesis: If the initial help or H2 supplies the entire gcd decision and final repeating class, D4 exception-sensitive APPLY has been bypassed; a solver that blindly applies pairwise-coprime CRT must fail.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Build a physically sound exterior-accessible table-edge model for a closed four-by-four border with a sealed two-by-two courtyard by distinguishing inaccessible inner boundary from open outer boundary, then rebuild the variable model when a removed top table connects the courtyard to the outside.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner chooses variables for occupied tables, shared edges and inaccessible courtyard edges, excludes eight sealed inner sides to give sixteen exterior-accessible chair sites, then recalculates adjacency and access after opening the top-row gap rather than simply subtracting four.

falsifier.hypothesis: If Core1A or H2 predefines the inaccessible cavity variable c and gives formula 4n-2e-c for this exact model, or transfer retains c=8 after opening, independent modelling is absent.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Translate a six-by-six domino-board obstruction into a local black/white bipartite-neighborhood shortage, finding three marked black cells with only two accessible white neighbors; transfer changes a hole and requires a full coordinate-pair matching rather than reusing the former obstruction.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner correctly identifies local S={(r1,c1),(r2,c2),(r1,c3)} with only two neighbors, proves no complete original tiling despite color balance, then constructs a valid complete fifteen-domino coordinate-pair covering for the changed board after the hole moves.

falsifier.hypothesis: If visual scaffolds provide the crucial 3-versus-2 local shortage witness or a purported transfer tiling fails to cover all thirty remaining cells exactly once, the REPRESENT-D4 intent is not demonstrated.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Select and coordinate an efficient valid ordering of alternating-sum divisibility-eleven, ending divisible-four and lexicographic minimality constraints over the fixed digit multiset 0,1,2,3,4,8, then redo global minimality under an additional divisible-by-seven requirement.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner constructs the least legal six-digit permutation (subject to no leading zero), verifies all three divisibility rules and argues no smaller prefix can work without unexamined cases, then independently searches/proves the new least admissible number divisible also by seven.

falsifier.hypothesis: If H2 dictates the decisive constraint order, the exact target prefix or an allegedly minimal candidate without a completeness argument, protected D4 SYNTHESIZE work is not learner-owned.

witnesses.question_specific_W: Prove both directions of the exact iff modular classification for all integers n satisfying 24|n²−1 with exceptional residue classes, then strengthen the same proof to 48|n²−1 by a factor-sixteen rather than factor-eight condition.
witnesses.success_evidence: Learner proves 24|n²−1 iff n≡1 or5 modulo6 using oddness and not-divisible-by-three, including n=3 as counterexample, then derives the extra n≡1 or7 modulo8 criterion together with the factor-three condition for 48.

falsifier.hypothesis: If the target iff residue classes or both necessity and sufficiency are displayed before learner commitment, checking example numbers or copying one direction cannot count as JUSTIFY-D4.
